title: Experience
subtitle: 本課限定語境：experience = knowledge, skill, or understanding gained through doing, seeing, or be
description: 本課限定語境：experience = knowledge, skill, or understanding gained through doing, seeing, or being involved in something · 「經驗／閱歷／實際接觸所得的知識」

words.note: 表示曾經接觸、見識或參與某個領域，因此對它有所了解。
words.example: She gained early exposure to coding at school.
words.exampleZh: 她在學校很早便接觸到編程。

exercises.original: She gained experience with coding at school, although she was still a beginner.
exercises.zh: 她在學校接觸過編程，但仍然是初學者。
exercises.upgrade: She gained exposure to coding at school.

options.explanation: still a beginner 顯示只是早期接觸，而非熟練。
表示反覆練習，比單純接觸更深入。
表示專業能力，和 beginner 衝突。
比 exposure 更強調親身理解。

exercises.original: The internship gave him experience of working in an international office.
exercises.zh: 實習讓他接觸到國際辦公室的工作環境。
exercises.upgrade: The internship gave him exposure to working in an international office.

options.explanation: 若重點是首次接觸一種工作環境，最自然。
若他實際負責很多工作則可能更合適。
比 exposure 更強調真正實務工作。
表示熟悉程度，不一定是實習所得。

exercises.original: Early experience of different cultures can broaden children's perspectives.
exercises.zh: 早期接觸不同文化可以擴闊兒童視野。
exercises.upgrade: Early exposure to different cultures can broaden children's perspectives.

options.explanation: 文化不是一項需要反覆練習的技能。
是整體過往背景，不是早期接觸行為。

words.note: 表示透過反覆進行某項活動而累積能力。
words.example: Regular practice improved his presentation skills.
words.exampleZh: 持續練習改善了他的簡報能力。

exercises.original: She gained experience in public speaking by presenting every week.
exercises.zh: 她透過每星期簡報累積公開演說經驗。
exercises.upgrade: She gained practice in public speaking by presenting every week.

options.explanation: every week 明確表示反覆練習。
表示熟悉，但不直接表示反覆做。
表示懂得怎樣做，未突出練習過程。

exercises.original: Students need more experience before they can perform the procedure confidently.
exercises.zh: 學生需要更多練習，才能有信心地完成程序。
exercises.upgrade: Students need more practice before they can perform the procedure confidently.

options.explanation: 只看過／接觸過不足以建立信心。
知道程序如何運作不等於練熟。
可能熟悉流程，但題句要求實際操作能力。

exercises.original: Experience is essential if you want to improve your pronunciation.
exercises.zh: 如果想改善發音，反覆練習必不可少。
exercises.upgrade: Regular practice is essential if you want to improve your pronunciation.

options.explanation: 發音能力靠重複練習提升。
聽很多英語有幫助，但不等於自己練發音。
是結果層級，不是學習手段。
知道發音規則不等於能發好。

words.note: 表示透過親自經歷、觀察或參與而獲得知識。
words.example: She has firsthand knowledge of how the system works.
words.exampleZh: 她親身了解這套系統如何運作。

exercises.original: Because she worked there for five years, she has direct experience of how the company operates.
exercises.zh: 因為她在那裡工作了五年，所以她親身了解公司如何運作。
exercises.upgrade: She has firsthand knowledge of how the company operates.

options.explanation: 親自在公司工作多年，因此知識來自直接經歷。
也可能熟悉，但不特別強調知識來自親身經驗。

exercises.original: The witness had personal experience of the event and could describe exactly what happened.
exercises.zh: 目擊者對事件有第一手了解，可以準確描述發生經過。
exercises.upgrade: The witness had firsthand knowledge of the event.

options.explanation: 親眼目睹事件，是典型第一手知識。
通常指實務工作／操作經驗。

exercises.original: Her experience of caring for an elderly relative gave her a clear understanding of the challenges.
exercises.zh: 照顧年長親屬的親身經驗讓她深入了解當中的挑戰。
exercises.upgrade: Her firsthand knowledge of the challenges came from caring for an elderly relative.

words.meaning: 實作經驗；親手操作經驗
words.note: 表示真正親自做過，而不是只讀過或聽過。
words.example: The course gives students hands-on experience with laboratory equipment.
words.exampleZh: 課程讓學生獲得實際操作實驗室設備的經驗。

exercises.original: The course gives students real experience using laboratory equipment.
exercises.zh: 課程讓學生獲得實際操作實驗室設備的經驗。
exercises.upgrade: The course gives students hands-on experience with laboratory equipment.

options.explanation: 核心是學生親自操作設備。
也很接近，但 hands-on 更直接突出親自操作。

exercises.original: Applicants should have experience installing and repairing the equipment themselves.
exercises.zh: 申請人應具備親自安裝和維修設備的實作經驗。
exercises.upgrade: Applicants should have hands-on experience installing and repairing the equipment.

options.explanation: themselves 直接指出親手做過。
可包含教育或其他經歷，太廣。
熟悉設備不等於親自維修。
懂得怎樣做很接近，但不證明親自做過。

exercises.original: The internship provides experience with real customer cases.
exercises.zh: 實習提供處理真實客戶個案的實作經驗。
exercises.upgrade: The internship provides hands-on experience with real customer cases.

options.explanation: 實際處理真實個案，最貼切。
表示熟悉但不一定做過。
只是動作名詞，不等於經驗。

words.meaning: 實務經驗；實際工作經驗
words.note: 表示在真實工作或實際情境中累積的經驗。
words.example: Applicants should have practical experience in project management.
words.exampleZh: 申請人應具備項目管理的實務經驗。

exercises.original: The role requires experience in managing budgets and staff.
exercises.zh: 這個職位要求具備管理預算和員工的實務經驗。
exercises.upgrade: The role requires practical experience in managing budgets and staff.

options.explanation: 真實工作情境中的管理經驗最自然。
也接近，但不一定需要「親手操作」意味。
僅熟悉概念不足以勝任管理。

exercises.original: Employers value experience gained through real workplace projects.
exercises.zh: 僱主重視透過真實職場項目取得的實務經驗。
exercises.upgrade: Employers value practical experience gained through real workplace projects.

options.explanation: real workplace projects 明確指實務情境。
偏理解，不一定能完成工作。

exercises.original: She has plenty of experience applying the theory in real situations.
exercises.zh: 她有很多把理論應用於真實情境的實務經驗。
exercises.upgrade: She has plenty of practical experience applying the theory in real situations.

options.explanation: theory → real situations 正是 practical experience 的核心。
只知道理論，和題句相反。

words.note: 表示自己直接經歷，而不是從別人得知。
words.example: His direct experience of the problem shaped his opinion.
words.exampleZh: 他對問題的親身經歷影響了他的看法。

exercises.original: His experience of the problem shaped his opinion because he had personally dealt with it.
exercises.zh: 因為他親自處理過這個問題，所以他的直接經驗影響了看法。
exercises.upgrade: His direct experience of the problem shaped his opinion.

options.explanation: personally dealt with it 直接表示親身經歷。
也很接近，但更強調由經歷所得的知識。

exercises.original: People with experience of the service were invited to give feedback.
exercises.zh: 曾親自使用這項服務的人獲邀提供意見。
exercises.upgrade: People with direct experience of the service were invited to give feedback.

options.explanation: 他們自己實際使用過服務。
可能只是接觸過資訊，不一定使用過。

exercises.original: Her experience of living abroad changed how she viewed cultural differences.
exercises.zh: 她在海外生活的直接經驗改變了她看待文化差異的方式。
exercises.upgrade: Her direct experience of living abroad changed her perspective.

options.explanation: 她本人真正生活過，不是間接得知。
也可能接觸文化，但不如 direct experience 強。

words.note: 表示因接觸或使用過某事物而對它熟悉。
words.example: Familiarity with the software is useful for this role.
words.exampleZh: 熟悉這套軟件對這個職位很有幫助。

exercises.original: Experience with this software is useful but not essential.
exercises.zh: 熟悉這套軟件有幫助，但並非必要。
exercises.upgrade: Familiarity with this software is useful but not essential.

options.explanation: 「有些了解、會基本使用」而非要求深入經驗。
遠比 useful but not essential 強。
也可表示接觸，但 familiarity 更強調已熟悉。
表示實際操作能力，強度較高。

exercises.original: Applicants need some experience with common accounting software.
exercises.zh: 申請人需要對常見會計軟件有一定熟悉程度。
exercises.upgrade: Applicants need some familiarity with common accounting software.

options.explanation: some 表示基本熟悉即可。
要求更高，暗示真實工作中用過。
不自然配 software 作此義。

exercises.original: His previous experience with the system helped him learn the new version quickly.
exercises.zh: 他之前對系統的熟悉令他很快學會新版本。
exercises.upgrade: His previous familiarity with the system helped him learn the new version quickly.

options.explanation: 已有熟悉程度，所以能快速適應新版本。
較正式，且更強調親身所得知識。
可表示接觸，但熟悉程度較弱。
表示使熟悉的過程，不是既有熟悉程度。

words.note: 表示一個人在教育、工作、訓練或某領域累積的整體經歷。
words.example: She has a strong background in finance.

exercises.original: She has extensive experience in finance and accounting.
exercises.zh: 她在金融和會計方面有豐富背景。
exercises.upgrade: She has a strong background in finance and accounting.

options.explanation: 可綜合表示教育、工作和相關經歷。
表示高程度專業能力，未必等同所有過往經歷。

exercises.original: The candidate has experience in engineering, project management, and operations.
exercises.zh: 候選人在工程、項目管理和營運方面有相關背景。
exercises.upgrade: The candidate has a broad background in engineering, project management, and operations.

options.explanation: 多個領域的整體過往經歷最自然。
不適合概括多領域職業經歷。
偏具體某件事的親身了解。
此處通常用單數抽象名詞。

exercises.original: Her experience in education made her well suited to the role.
exercises.zh: 她的教育背景令她很適合這個職位。
exercises.upgrade: Her background in education made her well suited to the role.

options.explanation: 整體教育／工作經歷令她適合職位。
不自然概括職業領域經歷。

words.note: 表示知道如何實際完成某件事。
words.example: The team has the technical know-how to maintain the system.
words.exampleZh: 團隊具備維護這套系統所需的技術實務知識。

exercises.original: The team has enough experience to maintain the system without outside help.
exercises.zh: 團隊有足夠實際操作知識，可以自行維護系統。
exercises.upgrade: The team has the know-how to maintain the system without outside help.

options.explanation: 重點是「知道實際怎樣維護」。
看過或接觸過不足以獨立維護。
也不足以證明能完成工作。
有證書不代表懂得實際操作。

exercises.original: Years of experience gave her the knowledge needed to solve difficult production problems.
exercises.zh: 多年經驗令她掌握解決困難生產問題所需的實際訣竅。
exercises.upgrade: Years of experience gave her the know-how to solve difficult production problems.

options.explanation: 強調可以實際解決問題的操作知識。
也可能正確，但更正式且表示較高專業水平。
是累積 know-how 的過程之一，但不是知識本身。

exercises.original: The technician's experience allowed him to repair the machine quickly.
exercises.zh: 技術員的實際操作知識讓他迅速修好機器。
exercises.upgrade: The technician's know-how allowed him to repair the machine quickly.

options.explanation: 能快速維修，突出「知道怎樣做」。
可表示親身了解，但不如 know-how 有實作技巧感。
可能熟悉機器，但未必懂維修。

words.meaning: 親身生活經歷；切身經驗
words.note: 表示某人實際生活中親身經歷某種情況。
words.example: The study included people with lived experience of homelessness.
words.exampleZh: 研究包括曾親身經歷無家可歸的人。

exercises.original: The study included people with personal experience of homelessness.
exercises.zh: 研究包括曾親身經歷無家可歸的人。
exercises.upgrade: The study included people with lived experience of homelessness.

options.explanation: 社會研究中，親身生活經歷某處境是標準用法。
太弱，可能只是接觸議題。

exercises.original: Policy makers consulted people with direct personal experience of the care system.
exercises.zh: 政策制定者諮詢曾親身經歷照護系統的人。
exercises.upgrade: Policy makers consulted people with lived experience of the care system.

options.explanation: 政策／社會服務語境中非常自然。
也接近，但較強調知識，而 lived experience 更強調生活經歷。
不是此概念的標準固定表達。

exercises.original: The panel wanted to hear from people with experience of disability in everyday life.
exercises.zh: 小組希望聽取在日常生活中有殘障親身經歷人士的意見。
exercises.upgrade: The panel wanted to hear from people with lived experience of disability.

options.explanation: 重點是本人生活中親身經歷。
可以熟悉議題但沒有親身經歷。
可能只是接觸過相關人士／資訊。
通常不是用來描述生活處境。
形容詞，常表示體驗式學習。

falseSynonyms.zh: 知識 ≠ 經驗 knowledge 可以從書本、課堂或別人獲得； experience 通常來自實際參與。
技能 ≠ 經驗 skill 是你能做甚麼； experience 是你做過多少、接觸過甚麼。
資格 ≠ 經驗 qualification 是證書、學歷或正式資歷。
訓練 ≠ 經驗本身 training 可以帶來 experience，但兩者不是同義詞。
專業能力 ≠ 一般經驗 expertise 通常代表很高程度的知識和能力； experience 可以很多，也可以很少。
接觸 ≠ 熟練經驗 接觸過某領域，不表示已能熟練工作。
詞形陷阱 - experience = 名詞／動詞 - experienced = 有經驗的 - experiential = 體驗式的
